Allowed, subject to all just exceptions. Application stands disposed of.
This petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C on behalf of the Petitioner seeking quashing of FIR No. 412/2022 dated 23.06.2022 registered under Sections 363/366/376 IPC at P.S. Patel Nagar.
